svg.title: Daily targets: selected classes and relationships

g.text: Daily targets: selected classes and relationships
Only feature-relevant members are shown; constructors, getters, and the other commands are omitted.
One TargetSettings object is created by Parser and shared by the three commands, as DietarySettings is.
The targets are read when a command executes, not when it is parsed.
Dashed arrows show dependencies or interface realization; solid arrows show stored references.
